name: Nexus Brain
description: The smart overlay brain for agent apps (two-brain architecture). Plug it in and the app gets SMARTER — reflex routing, graph memory with spreading-activation recall, a self-teaching coach, prompt refinement, context caching, dream cycles, whole-app directives AND the full gbrain memory model (pages with compiled truths, typed facts with conflict supersede, entity name-variant resolution, an always-loaded core memory tier, a retrieval ledger, interactive graph ops). Unplug it and the app's own spine brain keeps everything working like a normal LLM agent app (gbrain + graphify + HippoRAG + Generative Agents + Reflexion inspired).
architecture: two-brain: the host app keeps its own spine brain (LLM routing, planning, tools — always on); this module is the spirit overlay that makes it smarter while connected

host.state.get/set: durable storage for the brain connection state + app directives
host.capabilities(): snapshot of tools/skills/plugins/mcps installed in the host body
host.now(): clock access (the brain has no sense of time on its own)

provides.connect(): plug the brain in — overlay intelligence returns
provides.disconnect(): unplug the overlay — the host spine keeps the app fully alive (LLM routing, tools, planning, memory); only overlay features pause
provides.setAppPrefs(): issue app directives: chat tone, mission verbosity, auto-dream (honored app-wide while connected)
provides.think(): front door ROUTING for every message: chat (streamed answer next) or agent mission — never writes the answer itself
provides.answerMessages(): the persona prompt for the STREAMED chat answer (memories, recall citations, tone directive) — the host streams it token-by-token so answers appear as if typed

cognition.frontDoor: reflexes + a small fast router turn decide chat vs task; the streamed answer is composed separately so it can type out live
deterministicReflexes: image/drawing/logo/poster generation requests always escalate to agent mode
tts/voice, translation, code-execution and file requests always escalate
real-time research questions always escalate (except pure clock questions — answered from the prompt's own date line)

appControl.philosophy: the brain steers HOW the app thinks and speaks — never destructive, always reversible by disconnecting

memory.recall: human-brain scoring (Generative Agents): recency 0.995^Δh × importance (salience 1-10 tagged at write) × relevance (multi-query keyword fusion + graph activation), min-max normalized; Bjork storage/retrieval strength separation — successful hard recalls strengthen memory most (desirable difficulty); priming map carries activation across turns; pattern completion completes weak cues from matched key terms (CA3)
memory.graphMemory: every memory is indexed into an entity-relation graph (deterministic extraction, zero LLM at index time): recall runs Personalized PageRank over the entity graph (HippoRAG) under an explicit TOKEN BUDGET — only the activated subgraph ever enters a prompt; edges carry EXTRACTED/INFERRED provenance (graphify)
memory.dream: consolidation cycle — merges near-duplicates, senses latent relations, distills old memories into insights; hosts can run it manually or auto-dream via shouldAutoDream() when memory has grown (gbrain 24/7 dream cycle)

coach.review: after every mission the coach reflects (Reflexion): what worked, what wasted steps → at most 2 concrete lessons stored as procedural memories
coach.inject: before every mission the top-k lessons whose origin goal resembles the new task are injected into the planner prompt
coach.grade: use-attributed feedback (gbrain): lessons that help gain weight w ← w + α(1-w), lessons that ride failures decay w ← w(1-α); low-weight lessons stop being injected
coach.teach: teachFact() normalizes user-taught knowledge into high-salience memories

tokenEconomy.contextCache: in-memory LRU response cache with TTL for deterministic callers (routing, chips) + stats; cache-friendly prompt layout discipline: static persona → stable lists → stable memory → append-only history → volatile tail (provider KV-cache reuse)
tokenEconomy.promptRefine: decontextualization rewrites follow-ups into standalone queries before recall (LLM, heuristic-gated); deterministic query expansion fuses variants; one-round self-refine for planning artifacts

knowledgeGraph.edges: every edge tagged EXTRACTED (from app data), INFERRED (strong co-occurrence) or AMBIGUOUS (weak overlap) — graphify's transparency model
knowledgeGraph.queries: neighbors / path / stats, plus buildGraphReport() with god nodes, memory communities (label propagation), surprising cross-cluster connections and suggested questions
knowledgeGraph.rabbitHole: associative deep-dive: from a topic entity, hop outward preferring surprising edges (INFERRED + low-degree destinations) — the brain explores rabbit holes on purpose, with a map

gbrain.origin: port of garrytan/gbrain (MIT) — canonical sources vendored at gbrain/vendor/gbrain, attribution in gbrain/ATTRIBUTION.md
gbrain.writePath: gbrainRemember(): capture dedup (refresh, not duplicate) → one-line truth compile → typed-claim conflict supersede (stale facts marked + leave the core tier) → entity save-time resolution cascade (exact → alias → variant → new)
gbrain.entityResolution: name variants ranked strongest-first (normalized / honorific / reordered / diminutive / initial / typo / surname) with Damerau distance, nickname groups and corporate-suffix handling; weak matches resolve only when unique; near-matches are FLAGGED, never silently merged
gbrain.coreMemory: pages marked alwaysLoad render into EVERY prompt under one character budget (default 4000) — deterministic, zero LLM; marking refuses when the budget is full
gbrain.retrievalLedger: every recall recorded in a bounded ring buffer; recency-weighted use-attribution trust — memories that keep being used earn trust
gbrain.graphOps: node inspect / create / rename / alias / remove / orphan-prune — the brain auto-creates nodes from memory text and auto-prunes orphans; people can too (origin: auto | manual)

modules.core/gate.ts: connection gate — connect / disconnect / status + app-directive storage
modules.core/cognition.ts: thinking core — reflex + fast router (think), streamed-answer prompt builder (answerMessages), code-fence safety net
modules.core/appcontrol.ts: app-control surface — tone/verbosity directives, control summary for the UI
modules.core/capabilities.ts: capability registry — what the brain can reach in the host body
modules.core/recall.ts: human-brain memory recall: GenAgents scoring, Bjork strengths, priming, pattern completion, citations
modules.core/memory-graph.ts: graph memory — entity/triple extraction, memory graph, spreading activation, Personalized PageRank, token-budgeted graph recall, rabbit holes
modules.core/graph.ts: knowledge graph — heterogeneous nodes, provenance-tagged edges, communities, surprising connections, graph report
modules.core/dream.ts: dream cycle — memory consolidation planner + auto-dream gate
modules.core/coach.ts: the coach — Reflexion reviews after missions, lesson injection before missions, use-attributed grading, teach()
modules.core/cache.ts: context cache — LRU response cache with TTL + cache-friendly prompt layout
modules.core/refine.ts: prompt refinement — decontextualizing rewrite, query expansion, one-round self-refine
modules.gbrain/types.ts: the gbrain memory model + GBrainStore persistence contract (host implements, brain decides)
modules.gbrain/entities.ts: gbrain entity resolution — name variants, near-name flagging, save-time cascade
modules.gbrain/facts.ts: gbrain facts — typed claims, conflict supersede, capture dedup, truth compilation
modules.gbrain/core-memory.ts: gbrain always-loaded tier — char-budgeted core memory rendered into every prompt
modules.gbrain/remember.ts: the gbrain write path — every memory in the app flows through it
modules.gbrain/vendor/gbrain/: canonical upstream sources (MIT, reference only, excluded from compilation)
modules.types.ts: BrainHost adapter contract, route decisions, app prefs
modules.index.ts: createBrain(host) — the single public entry point

guarantees: Disconnecting the brain never deletes or disables host capabilities — they stay installed in the body.
A disconnected brain is never consulted: the host spine answers with full LLM power; the app never goes dumb.
App directives only apply while connected — disconnecting reverts the app to default behavior, nothing is lost.
The brain holds no app-specific imports — it can be dropped into any TypeScript app that provides BrainHost.
